title: Voltorb's Rolling Movement Has One Explosive Risk

direction.premise: Voltorb rolls to move, and a bump on uneven ground can cause it to explode.
direction.audiencePromise: See how Voltorb's rolling movement becomes dangerous when uneven ground delivers a sudden jolt.
direction.openLoop: How can one bump turn Voltorb's movement into an explosion?
direction.payoff: Voltorb's rolling movement has a dangerous condition: a bump on uneven ground can trigger an explosion.
direction.engagementQuestion: Clever design, or too dangerous to trust?

voice.instructions: Sound like a knowledgeable fan telling a friend something surprising. Use quick, warm pacing with extra stress on bump, jolt, and explode. Keep each line crisp and conversational.
